precision: bf16 autocast; FP32 parameters, optimizer and EMA
schedule: constant original learning rate; no convergence early stop
optimizer_boundary: Original paper-branch final files contain no optimizer or RNG. Restore raw and EMA weights; initialize a new AdamW and record the boundary explicitly. This is weight continuation, not bitwise continuation of the old optimizer trajectory.
training_data: Existing core.active: first N of S1, last N of S2; image-disjoint groups
synchronization: All four workers finish preflight and wait at a barrier; one common start time and ten-hour deadline
checkpoint_contents: AdamW including moments and optimizer step
checkpoint_policy: Immutable full checkpoints at global multiples of 500000; initial replay-check checkpoint and final checkpoint; atomic rename, SHA256 and reload validation; retain every committed checkpoint
evaluation: Before and after continuation: paired image-disjoint train/other panels, raw and EMA, per-time velocity MSE and clean-readout MSE. Diagnostic samples are separate from the training RNG.
user_confirmed_startpoint_change: After the two archived N10000 300k checkpoints were found missing, the user explicitly chose all four existing paper-branch 200k checkpoints; new AdamW is confirmed.
memory_policy: Only active training images on GPU and two 512-image CPU panels; sequential full recovery tests; reuse old recovery files after exact first-update tensor, optimizer and RNG equality verification. No old files are deleted.
